name: Past Paper
statement: The product of all the digits of a positive integer is called the "digit product" of that integer. For example: the digit product of 4 is 4; the digit product of 56 is $5 \times 6 = 30$; the digit product of 789 is $7 \times 8 \times 9 = 504$. Among the integers from 1 to 2025, how many integers have a digit product of 8?
